result.notes:
Job Bank receives and displays job postings in two main ways. The first method is through employers who create an account and advertise jobs directly on Job Bank's website. Job postings advertised directly on Job Bank include information such as the job title, codes from the National Occupational Classification (NOC) and the North American Industry Classification System (NAICS), work location, number of vacancies, salary and benefits, hours of work, job requirements, and employment terms. 

The second method is through external contributors, who are private and provincial job boards which Job Bank has agreements with. Job Bank displays job postings meeting specific eligibility criteria that are shared by external contributors through XML feeds. Job postings received from external contributors include information such as the job title, code from the NOC, work location, salary, hours of work, and employment terms. A cell containing NA indicates that the information was not available.

Job postings advertised directly on Job Bank include information such as the job title, codes from the National Occupational Classification (NOC) and the North American Industry Classification System (NAICS), work location, number of vacancies, salary and benefits, hours of work, job requirements, and employment terms. 

The second method is through external contributors, who are private and provincial job boards which Job Bank has agreements with. Job Bank displays job postings meeting specific eligibility criteria that are shared by external contributors through XML feeds. Job postings received from external contributors include information such as the job title, code from the NOC, work location, salary, hours of work, and employment terms. A cell containing NA indicates that the information was not available.
notes_translated.fr:
Le Guichet-Emplois reçoit et affiche des offre d'emplois de deux manières principales. La première manière est par le biais d'employeurs qui créent un compte et publient des offres d'emploi directement sur le site Web du Guichet-Emplois. Les offres d'emploi publiées directement sur le Guichet-Emplois contiennent des renseignements tels que l'appellation d'emploi, les codes de la Classification nationale des professions (CNP) et du Système de classification des industries de l'Amérique du Nord (SCIAN), le lieu de travail, le nombre de postes vacants, le salaire et les avantages sociaux, les heures de travail, les exigences du poste et les conditions d'emploi. 

La deuxième manière repose sur la collaboration avec des contributeurs externes, qui sont des sites d'emploi privés et provinciaux avec lesquels le Guichet-Emplois a conclu un accord. Le Guichet-Emplois affiche les offres d'emploi répondant à certains critères d'admissibilité partagées par les contributeurs externes au moyen de fils XML. Les offres d'emploi partagées par les contributeurs externes contiennent des renseignements tels que l'appellation d'emploi, le code de la CNP, le lieu de travail, le salaire, les heures de travail et les conditions d'emploi. Une cellule contenant NA indique que l’information n’était pas disponible.
